groups.title: Look Up
groups.note: Wonder spreading. 1: two kids point up at the Atomium; the discovery starts with children. 2: a grown man raises his arm to a kite between the towers; an adult joins in. 3: a couple stands close under a needle with a giant insect on top; now it's shared. 4: indoors, a whole crowd tilts their heads to a painted ceiling. From one child's finger to everyone.

groups.title: Growing Up
groups.note: A childhood in four frames. 1: by the lake a man reaches down for a small child's hand. 2: at a concert a mother holds one child while another rides on shoulders; still carried. 3: a man points a child to a sign that reads 'we are building something big'; being shown the future. 4: a child races ahead on a scooter, the parent's bike now behind. Ends with letting go. 03 and 54 are colour; 46 and 65 B&W.

groups.title: From Dark to Light
groups.note: A walk through Design Week. 1: a man steps through a black doorway; we go in with him. 2: heads pushed into a porthole; curiosity. 3: a child crouched alone inside a black box; hiding, or lost. 4: faces in a narrow slit; looking for a way out. 5: outside in the white, an old woman watches a boy cross; the light, and someone keeping watch.

groups.title: Waiting for the Dance
groups.note: From loneliness to joining in. 1: at night a man stands on his phone as shoppers blur past him. 2: a man leans on a shutter, waiting, while people stream by. 3: at a concert, a man watches two women dance, close to the joy but not in it. 4: on the steps, couples dance together and people gather round. The loner finally joins.

groups.title: What We're Sold
groups.note: How wanting is made and passed on. 1: a model checks her luxury watch on a billboard while a man hauls cardboard below; the image goes up. 2: women stop at a shop window, one photographing the mannequin; the wanting starts. 3: a child drags her mother towards a giant shoe under a billboard face; it's passed to the next generation. 4: a mural boy holds his face in his hands as passers-by look at their phones; what's left is emptiness.

groups.title: Inheritance
groups.note: The old hand the city to the young. 1: old men on a bench watch the bocce game; the elders. 2: a toddler stands before a classical statue; first meeting with the past. 3: two girls in First Communion veils pass under the castle gate; a ritual, a passage. 4: young women laugh under a bronze horseman at sunset; the city is theirs now.

groups.title: The Way Out
groups.note: From confinement to freedom. 1: tiny figures squeezed into a strip of light between dark walls. 2: a lone figure stands under an arch in the rain, looking out. 3: a bird lifts off above a crowd held back behind a fence. 4: a boy spins freely in an open square under a storm sky.

groups.title: The Show
groups.note: A spectacle seen by those who don't care. 1: a crowd pressed against railings under a giant laughing face. 2: men dwarfed beneath a towering printed figure. 3: visitors circle a yacht model in the dark, silent. 4: in the Galleria, adults kneel to photograph while a toddler stretches in total boredom. The punchline.

groups.title: Companions
groups.note: A dog's way from carried to free (it mirrors 'Growing Up'). 1: a dog's head out of a bag; it only sees legs. 2: a dog in a backpack, high up, looks straight at us. 3: a dog on the ground beside its man, watching boys play football. 4: a dog runs and plays with its owner under the vertical forest.

groups.title: Side by Side
groups.note: Company through a day, standing to resting. 1: two men at a lake railing, looking at the water. 2: a couple stops for a selfie by a canal. 3: pairs sit along a riverbank. 4: two men rest at the base of a statue, a shoe left on the ground; the day is done.

groups.title: Who's Watching
groups.note: The camera gets caught. 1: a man waves at the photographer while someone hides in a photo booth beside him. 2: a woman poses on a post in the street under a painted woman. 3: a giant toy unicorn stares out of a shop window, straight back at us.
